title: Bug: AAPS 3.3.3.0-dev-d Carb entries not possible; all Versions
symptom: Carb entries are not possible via the treatments button; the action is not processed even though carbs were entered. A message appears: 'Kohlenhydrate. Carbohydrates. No action selected, nothing will happen'.
cause: MilosKozak suggests this can happen when trying to enter negative carbs with absolute value larger than COB (Final COB cannot be negative), but the reporter disputes this, stating COB was 53g and intended treatment was -3g.
fix: The issue was resolved in a more recent build; the reporter states 'works again in most recent build'.
evidence_quote: works again in most recent build.
